name: Vansen ArcWarm Heated Glove — Chrome-Socket Fit
description: Thick neoprene-shell gloves with embedded resistive heating wire and a reinforced chrome-socket palm that accommodates partial hand augmentations and wrist interface ports. The heating system is powered by a slim battery cell worn at the wrist, giving 8 hours of warmth at -30C. Available in black and gunmetal.
functionality: Active resistive heating rated to -30C wind chill; palm socket accommodates partial hand chrome and wrist interface hardware without pressure points.
what_it_says: Someone who invested in proper aug-compatible winter gear — not rich, but not cutting corners on their hands.
worn_by: small business owners with chrome hands
story_hooks: The battery cell has been modified to run hotter than spec — whoever did it knew exactly how close to the thermal limit they could push.
One glove's socket fit is calibrated for a rare discontinued chrome model; whoever owned these had very specific hardware.

physical_description.visual_profile: Utilitarian mitt-style glove with a bulkier, tech-forward silhouette. The chrome-socket palm catches light distinctly, creating a cyborg-ready aesthetic. Wrist cuff is engineered and structured, suggesting integrated hardware. Reads as working-class augmentation wear rather than fashion.
physical_description.fit: Snug compression fit through the fingers and palm, with generous wrist cuff designed to accommodate interface ports and battery cell. Neoprene conforms to the hand but leaves room for subdermal hardware and augmentation mounts.
physical_description.primary_material: High-grade neoprene shell with inner thermal lining; reinforced chrome-alloy socket embedded in palm; conductive thread tracing for heating element distribution
physical_description.texture: Smooth neoprene exterior with slight grip texture on palm. Chrome socket area is cool and metallic to touch, with visible weld seams. Wrist cuff has subtle ribbing for seal integrity.
physical_description.color_scheme: Predominantly matte black with gunmetal chrome accents on palm socket and wrist hardware. Heating wire visible as faint copper traces beneath translucent neoprene.
physical_description.closures: Friction-fit wrist cuff with integrated magnetic snap tabs; chrome socket uses precision-fit design rather than visible closure
distinctive_features: Chrome-alloy socket palm with augmentation mounting points
Embedded resistive heating wire throughout neoprene
Wrist battery cell dock with visible connector port
Slight wear expected on chrome socket from handling
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 3–4 functional wear; signals working-class augmentation use and climate-intensive labor
physical_description.cultural_context: Worn by field technicians, industrial workers, augmentation-integrated laborers in cold-zone operations. Signals practical body modification and outdoor endurance work in the GLMZ.
physical_description.condition_typical: Broken-in and heavily used; chrome socket shows patina and micro-scratches; neoprene may have minor creasing at knuckles and wrist
